groups.name: namastack.outbox.observability.metrics
groups.description: Background collection of outbox state gauges

properties.name: namastack.outbox.observability.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register state gauges and collect their values in the background. Disabling state metrics also stops their database queries. Observation-based timers are unaffected.

properties.name: namastack.outbox.observability.metrics.refresh-interval
properties.description: Delay between completed background collections of outbox state gauges. Must be at least 1ms. Collections do not overlap.

properties.name: namastack.outbox.observability.metrics.max-age
properties.description: Maximum age of each collected gauge reading. Readings report NaN once they reach this age, including while collection is blocked. Must be at least refresh-interval.
